v: aBiBA
strI aBi + BA--aN । 1 aBiBave “mA tvA kAcidaBiBA viSvyAvidat” f॰ 2, 42, 1 । “aBiBA aBiBavaH” BA॰ ।
m: 1. अभि-√ भा to glitter (around), be bright, appear, MBh. &c.
2. अभि-भा f. ‘apparition, phenomenon’, inauspicious omen, RV. ii, 42, 1; AV.
(with, Buddh.) act of overpowering, superiority, L.
a: अभिभा — {c2c} P. To glitter or shine; दिवि स्थितः सूर्य इवाभिभाति Mb.
अभिभा — Ved. [अभिभा-अङ्] 1 Apparition, phenomenon; an inauspicious omen. --2 A calamity, state of being overpowered. --3 Superiority.

v: aBiBAra
tri॰ aBirBfSArTe atiSayito BAro yasya । atiBAvAnvite “caturupamfti tadvajramaBiBAraM karoti tena vajreRABiBAreRemA~ lokAn praBinatti” Sata॰ brA॰ ।
m: अभि-भार See अभि-√ भृ.
अभि-भार mfn. very heavy, ŚBr.

v: aBiBAvaka
tri॰ aBi + BU--Rvul । 1 aBiBavakarttari 2 tiraskArake 3 parAjetari 4 jaqIBAvakArake ca ।
m: अभि-भावक mfn. overpowering, surpassing Comm. on Nyāyad.
अभि-भावन n. causing to overcome, making victorious, L.

v: aBiBAvin
tri॰ aBiBavati aBi + BU--Rini striyAM NIp । 1 tiraskArake 2 parAjetari “sarvAtiriktasAreRa sarvatejo'BiBAvinA” raGuH । tfc । aBiBavitApyatra ।
m: अभि-भाविन् mfn. (ifc.) overpowering, Ragh. i, 14, &c.
a: अभिभाविन्, --भाव(वु)क — a. 1 Overpowering, defeating, conquering; शोकाभिभाविना भयेनाभिभूता K. 170 fear which conquered grief. --2 Surpassing, excelling; सर्वतेजोभिभाविना R. 1. 14; Ki. 11. 6. --3 Disrespecting, humiliating. --4 Attacking.

v: aBiBAvuka
tri॰ aBi + BU--ukaY । 1 tiraskArake 2 parAjetari 3 jaqIBAvakArake ca ।
m: अभि-भावुक mfn. = अभि-भावक, L.
अभिभायतन n. ‘abode of superiority’, N. of the eight sources of superiority with Buddhists, L.
अभि-√ भाष् to address, speak to (acc.), MBh. &c.; converse with (instr.), Mn. &c.; to utter, say (अभिभाषन्ते, ‘people use to say’, Nir.); to confess, Mn. xi, 103.
a: अभिभाष् — A. (P. in epic poetry) 1 To speak to, address; talk or converse with (with acc.); भोभवत्पूर्वकं त्वेनमभिभाषेत धर्मवित् Ms. 2. 128; sometimes with instr. also; Ms. 4. 57. --2 To speak, say (as वाणीं, वचः &c.); इति अभिभाषंते so they say. --3 To relate, narrate, speak of. --4 To proclaim, announce, confess; Ms. 11. 104.

v: aBiBAzaRa
na॰ ABimuKyena BAzaRam prA॰ sa॰ । 1 ABimuKyena kaTane ।
m: अभि-भाषण n. the act of addressing or speaking to, ĀśvŚr. &c.
a: अभिभाषणं — Speaking to, addressing, conversing with.

v: aBiBAzin
tri॰ ABimuKyena BAzate aBi + BAza--Rini striyAM NIp । ABimuKyena BAziRi । “prasannamuKarAgaM taM smitapUrvvABiBAziRam” raGuH ।
m: अभि-भाषिन् mfn. addressing, speaking to.
a: अभिभाषिन् — a. Addressing, speaking to; speaking, talking; स्मितपूर्वाभिभाषिणं R. 17. 31 whose words are preceded by a smile, speaking with a smile.

m: अभि-भाषित mfn. addressed, spoken to.
अभि-भाषित n. pl. words, BhP.
अभि-भाष्य mfn. to be addressed.
अभि-भाष्यमाण mfn. being addressed.

v: aBiBU
tri॰ aBiBavati aBi + BU--kvip । 1 aBiBAvake 2 tiraskArake “aBiBuve aBiBaNgAya banvate” f॰ 2, 21, 2, “aBiBuve aBiBavitre” BA॰ ।
m: 1. अभि-√ भू to overcome, overpower, predominate, conquer, surpass, overspread; to attack, defeat, humiliate; to approach, come near to (acc.), RV. iv, 31, 3; AV.; to be victorious or prospering in (loc.), RV. v, 37, 5.
a: अभिभू — {c1c} P. 1 To overcome, subdue, conquer, vanquish (of persons or things); prevail over, predominate, defeat; (hence) excel, surpass; अभिभवति मनः कदंबवायौ Ki. 10. 23; अभिभूय विभूतिमार्तवीं R. 8. 36; 4. 56; 6. 29, 16. 10; K. 52, 53; Mu. 3. 20; Ms. 7. 5; धर्मे नष्टे कुलं कृत्स्नमधर्मोऽभिभवत्युत Bg. 1. 40 predominates over, overpowers; so शोकाभिभूत, विपद्˚, काम˚ &c. --2 To attack, seize or fall upon, assail; विपदोऽ भिभवंत्यविक्रमं Ki. 2. 14; अभ्यभावि भरताग्रजस्तया R. 11. 16, 84; Bṛ. S. 33. 30; ममापि सत्त्वैरभिभूयंते गृहाः Ś. 6 infested; परित्रायध्वं मामनेन मधुकरेणाभिभूयमानां Ś. 1 attacked, troubled; अभ्यभून्निलयं भ्रातुः Bk. 6. 117. --3 To humiliate, mortify, insult, disrespect; अंडभंगाभिभूता Pt. 1. --4 To go up to, turn to or towards (Ved.) --Caus. To overpower, surpass, defeat &c.

s: tri, (aBi + BU + ktaH .) jYAnarahitaH । tatparyyAyaH । itikarttavyatAmUQaH 2 vihastaH 3 vyAkulaH 4 aBimAyaH 5 viklavaH 6 vihvalaH 7 । iti jawADaraH ॥ parABUtaH । BadmadarpaH । tatparyyAyaH । AttagarvvaH 2 । iti jawADaraH ॥ AttaganDaH 3 । ityamaraH ॥ aBihataH 4 । iti tawwIkA ॥ (“dEtyABiBUtasya yuvAmavoQaM magnasya dorBirBuvanasya BAram” । iti BawwiH .)
v: aBiBUta
tri॰ aBi + BU--kta । 1 kiM karttavyamiti jYAnaSUnye, 2 parABUte, 3 vyAkule ca । “sajvareRABiBUta” iti jyo॰ ।
m: अभि-भूत mfn. surpassed, defeated, subdued, humbled
overcome, aggrieved, injured.

k.v: आत्तगर्वोऽभिभूतः स्याद्दापितः साधितः समौ। प्रत्यादिष्टो निरस्तः स्यात्प्रत्याख्यातो निराकृतः॥

s: strI, (aBi + BU + BAve ktin .) anAdaraH । avajYA । iti SabdaratnAvalI । (parABavaH । parAjayaH । mAnaBaNgaH । nikAraH । “aBiBUtiBayAdasUnataH suKamuhyanti na DAma mAninaH” । iti BAraviH .)
v: aBiBUti

strI aBi + BU--ktin । 1 parABave 2 avajYAyAYca aBiBavati karttari ktic । 3 aBiBAvake tri॰ । “gAyatryE Candase aBiBUtyE svAhA” kAtyA॰ 252 । “yasya pUrbI rdyornakzatramaBiBUti puzyAt” f॰ 4, 21, 1 । aBiBUti aBiBAvukaM valam” BA॰ । ataH saMgfByABiBUta ABara” f॰ 1, 5, 3, 3 । “aBiBUte, SatrURAmaBiBavitaH” BA॰ ।
m: अभि-भूति f. superior power, overpowering, RV. iv, 38, 9; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
disrespect, humiliation, L.
a partic. Ekāha, Vait.
अभि-भूति mfn. overpowering, superior, RV.; AV.
a: अभिभूति — a. That which defeats, conquers &c. --तिः 1 Predominance, prevalence, excessive or superior power. --2 Conquering, defeat, subjugation; अभिभूतिभयादसूनतः सुखमुज्झंति न धाम मानिनः Ki. 2. 20. --3 Disrespect, disgrace, humiliation. --Comp. --ओजस् a. of superior or predominant power. (--n.). superior power.

m: अभिभूत्य्-ओजस् (6) mfn. having superior power, RV.

v: aBiBUvan
tri॰ aBi + BU--Nvanip striyAM NIp raSca । aBiBAvake “samajEzamimA ahaM sapatnIraBiBUvarIH” f॰ 10, 159, 9 ।
m: अभि-भूवन् mf(वरी)n. superior, victorious over, RV. x, 159, 5 and 6.
a: अभिभूवन् — a. Ved. Prevailing or victorious over; surpassing.

v: aBiBUya
na॰ aBi + BU--BAve ‘Buvo BAve’ pA॰ kyap । aBitoBAve “aBiBUyAya tvA rAzwram” aTa॰ 19, 37, 3 । aBi + BU--lyap । tiraskftyerTe avya॰ ।
m: अभि-भूय n. superiority, AV. xix, 37, 3.
अभि-√ भूष् to adorn, Vṛṣabhān.

a: अभिभंगः — 1 Breaking down. --2 One who breaks down or destroys.

v: aBiBaNga
tri॰ aBitoBaNgoyasmAt । 1 BaNgahetO “aBiBuve'BiBaNgAya vanvate” f॰ 2, 21, 2, aBitoBaNgaH । 2 sarvatoBaNge pu॰ । aBimatoBaNgo yasya । 3 BaNgarSIle tri॰ ।
m: अभि-भङ्ग mfn. breaking down, destroying, RV. ii, 21, 3.
अभि-√ 2. भञ्ज् (p. gen. pl. f. -भञ्जतीनाम्) to break down, destroy, RV. x, 103, 8.
अभि-√ भज् to turn or flee towards (acc.), Hariv.
अभि-भर्तृ ind. towards the husband, Śiś. ix, 35
before (i.e. in presence of) the husband, Śiś. ix, 77.
अभि-√ भर्त्स् (ind.p. -भर्त्स्य) to scold, threaten so as to terrify, R.; to deride, ridicule, MBh. iii, 10921.

s: puM, (aBi + BU + BAve ap .) garvvanASaH । pariBavaH । parABavaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI hemacandraSca ॥ (parAjayaH । tiraskAraH । “raGoraBiBavASaNki cukzuBe dvizatAM manaH” । iti raGuvaMSe । “balavAnapi nistejAH kasya nABiBavAspadaM” । iti hitopadeSe .)
v: aBiBava

pu॰ aBi + BU--ap । parAjaye, tiraskAre, anAdare, ca । “raGoraBiBavASaNki cukzuBe dvizatAM manaH” raGuH “alaByaSokABiBaveyamAkftirvimAnanA suBru! kutaH piturgfhe” ku॰ “aDarmABiBavAccEva praduzyanti kulastriyaH” gItA । rogAdinA gAtrAdijaqIBAve “vfzasiMha vfScikaGawErvidDi sTAnaM gamAgamOna staH । na mftaM na cApi nazwaM na rogaSAntirnacABiBavaH” zaw paYcASikA ।
m: अभि-भव See 1. अभि-√ भू below.
अभि-भव mfn. overpowering, powerful, AV. i, 29, 4
अभि-भव (अस्), m. prevailing, overpowering, predominance, Bhag. &c.
defeat, subjugation under (instr. or abl., or in comp.)
disregard, disrespect
humiliation, mortification.
a: अभिभवः — 1 Defeat, subjugation, subjection, overpowering; इतरेतरानभिभवेन मृगास्तमुपासते गुरुमिवांतसदः Ki. 6. 34 (cf. K. 45 and the Bible “The wolf shall also dwell with the lamb” &c.); 8. 28; स्पर्शानुकूला इव सूर्यकांतास्तदन्यतेजोभिभवाद्वमंति Ś. 2. 7 when assailed, opposed, overpowered by another energy; अभिभवः कुत एव सपत्नजः R. 9. 4, 4. 21. --2 Being overpowered; जराभिभवविच्छायं K. 346; being attacked or affected, stupefied (by fever &c.); न रोगशांतिर्न चाभिभवः Suśr. --3 Contempt, disrespect; निरभिभवसाराः परकथाः Bh. 2. 64. --4 Humiliation, mortification (of pride); अलभ्यशोकाभिभवेयमाकृतिः Ku. 5. 43; K. 195. --5 Predominance, prevalence, rise, spread; अधर्माभिभवात्कृष्ण प्रदुष्यंति कुलस्त्रियः Bg. 1. 41; Ki. 2. 37.

m: अभि-भवनीय mfn. to be overcome.

v: aBiBavana
na॰ aBi + BU--lyuw । 1 aBiBave rogAdinAjYAnaroDe “jarayA cABiBavanaM vyADiBiScopapIqanam” manuH
m: अभि-भवन n. overpowering, Lalit.
the state of being overpowered, Mn. vi, 62.
a: अभिभवनं — Overpowering, overcoming, being subjected to or overpowered by; Ms. 6. 62.

m: अभि-√ भृ (Subj. -भराति) to lay or throw upon (as a fault or blame), RV. v, 3, 7.

अभि-भु or 2. अभि-भू, mfn. one who surpasses, a superior (with or without acc.), RV.; AV.; VS.; (Compar. अभिभूतर, RV. viii, 97, 10); (उस्), m., N. of a month, Kāṭh.; (ऊस्), m., N. of a die, TS.; Kāṭh.; of a prince of the Nāgas, PārGṛ.
a: अभिभुः --भूः — Ved. One who surpasses or prevails over, a superior.

m: अभि-√ 3. भुज् P. to be useful to (acc.), ŚāṅkhŚr.
